steps.name: Show pizza dough pls
positives: A plain and empty pizza base or dough is clearly visible. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add ham
positives: Slices of ham are evenly distributed on the pizza. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add mushrooms
positives: Do you see sliced mushrooms spread evenly across the pizza base, covering a large part of it. Only answer with [yes] or [no]
negatives: are the mushrooms incorrectly placed in the center of the pizza, covering a small part. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add basil
positives: Do you see at least multiple green basil leaves are clearly visible on top of the pizza. Only answer with [yes] or [no]
